18.name: Asha arrives at the firm's garage
18.description: Asha drives into the garage under the firm's building after crossing the river bridges.
evidence: The drive thinned out past the river bridges, and by the time Asha pulled into the garage under the firm's building

18.name: Asha enters the building before dawn
18.description: She arrives early enough that it is still dark and the attendant barely acknowledges her.
evidence: it was still dark enough that the attendant only nodded her through without looking up

18.name: Asha carries her decision to Whitfield's office
18.description: She rides the elevator with her briefcase, mentally holding onto a decision she made earlier in the study.
evidence: She rode the elevator with the briefcase against her thigh and the decision she had made in the study sitting quiet inside it

18.name: Asha finds Whitfield already in his office
18.description: In the hallway outside Whitfield's office, she sees that he is already inside and occupied with something else.
evidence: The hallway outside Whitfield's office was lit only by the desk lamps that had been left on overnight, and she could see, through the half-open door, that he was already there, already in his chair, already turning a page on something that was not her.

18.name: Asha sets down her briefcase outside the office
18.description: She places the briefcase on a chair outside Whitfield's door and pauses with her hand on the latch.
evidence: She set the briefcase down on the chair outside his door and stood for a moment with her hand on the latch

18.name: Asha prepares to make her decision public
18.description: She recognizes that speaking to Whitfield will turn her private decision into an official record.
evidence: because what she had decided to say to him would, the moment she said it, stop being a decision and start being a record.

18.name: Devin texts Asha to talk
18.description: Asha receives a message from Devin at 5:43 a.m. saying they need to talk.
evidence: Then her phone buzzed against her hip, and when she lifted it she saw it was not Whitfield's assistant and not the hospital but Devin, at five forty-three in the morning, the message only three words long: we need to talk.

18.name: Asha ignores Devin's message
18.description: She rereads the text, turns the phone face down, and does not move away from Whitfield's door.
evidence: Asha read the three words again in the dim hallway, then turned the phone face down against her palm so the screen went dark. She did not step back toward the stairwell.

18.name: Asha holds position at Whitfield's door
18.description: She keeps her hand on the latch and lets another phone alert go unanswered.
evidence: She kept her other hand on the latch of Whitfield's door, registering the small cold of the brass under her thumb, and let the buzz that followed, a second alert or the same one repeating, pass without lifti

18.name: feels brass latch cold
18.description: She rests her hand on Whitfield's door latch and notices the cold brass under her thumb.
evidence: t her other hand on the latch of Whitfield's door, registering the small cold of the brass under her thumb

18.name: ignores repeated phone alert
18.description: She lets a buzzing phone alert go unanswered instead of checking it.
evidence: let the buzz that followed, a second alert or the same one repeating, pass without lifting the phone to check

18.name: picks up briefcase by handle
18.description: She takes the briefcase from the chair and deliberately carries it by the handle rather than the spine.
evidence: The briefcase was still on the chair beside her, and she picked it up by the handle rather than the spine

18.name: remembers prior carrying choice
18.description: She reflects that carrying the briefcase by the spine in the car had been a different decision.
evidence: because the spine was what she had carried it by in the car and that had been a different decision

18.name: opens Whitfield's door
18.description: She pushes Whitfield's door fully open and enters the room.
evidence: Then she pushed the door the rest of the way open and went in

18.name: leaves Devin's message unanswered
18.description: She enters the room while leaving Devin's message unread and unanswered on her phone.
evidence: leaving Devin's message unanswered on a screen no one in the room would see
